text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, Bright-san! Are you heading out?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My~, Spe-sama, good day to you.
I was just on my way to buy a present
for Ryan-oneesama~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wah, how wonderful~! It's so nice
to pick out presents for people who are precious to you...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's it! May I come along with you?
I'd love to get something for Suzuka-san!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I managed to buy mine without a hitch!
Have you decided on yours, Bright-san?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...No, I am still undecided. I have already
gifted Oneesama just about everything ordinary.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I believe I will look around other shops~.
Since it is an important gift, I wish to be thorough.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Please feel free to do your own shopping, Spe-sama.
People often tell me that I take my time
with everything I do, you see~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
No way, I'll help you! 
Let's find the perfect gift together!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to Ryan-san, training immediately comes to mind,
so workout gear seems like a great fit...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That item over there says it's a new release!
"For a more beautiful and expressive tail—"
Huh, tail training gear, huh...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, how novel. If it is that,
Oneesama surely does not own one yet~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Alright then, I'll try it out
and see how it works!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
M-My tail is buzzing with electricity...?! 
T-This current trains the tail muscles, huh!
Alright, let's switch to high power—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
!? Hyahyaghyahya...!! 
I-It tickles! S-Someone turn it off~~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Spe-sama, are you alright...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I-I guess I messed up the power setting... 
Let's go look for another product... Ahahaha...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
There has to be something that's just right!
I'll stick with you until we find it, no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Bright-san, look at this!
They're milk cookies with added protein!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, these seem lovely~!
Ryan-oneesama was looking for snacks
she could enjoy casually.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And they're made with Hokkaido milk too!
I'll give one a taste test♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the food~! Mmm, nom nom,
mmngh?! T-Thith ith...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~! It's so delicious~~!
The fresh milk flavor spreads all through my mouth!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My! That is quite the seal of approval
from you, Spe-sama.
Let us purchase this one, then♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yay!
I'll buy a bag for Suzuka-san too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad we settled on a gift!
I hope Ryan-san loves it~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I am truly grateful to you
for staying with me all day~. Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ? Bright-san, is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I was simply recalling
how you were behaving earlier, Spe-sama.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You pondered so earnestly,
just as if you were picking out a gift of your own—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Spe-sama, you truly have
such a wonderful heart.

While walking through the academy, I spotted Special Week
looking rather happy about something.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes! Someone just told me that I have a wonderful heart.
Lately, I've been getting complimented a lot... Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Even though there are still so many things about myself
that I want to fix...
choice_data_list: It means you're wonderful just the way you are!
It means you're wonderful just the way you are!
What kind of things do you want to fix?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Even though there are still so many things about myself
that I want to fix...
choice_data_list: It means you're wonderful just the way you are!
It means you're wonderful just the way you are!
What kind of things do you want to fix?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Just the way I am...
It doesn't quite click for me, but—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Still...
Hmm, I see...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
U-Umm... like being clumsy,
and kind of a scatterbrain, and...
choice_data_list: Maybe that's part of what makes you so approachable.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Approachable, you say...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I-I see... I've never really thought about it that way before, desu ne...
I see... approachable, huh...
